assistant-followup.question: How do the encoder-decoder models behave within their training-time context length?
assistant-followup.answer: Within their encoder training-time context length, Flan-UL2 and Flan-T5-XXL are relatively robust to the position of relevant information. Flan-UL2 was trained with 2,048-token sequences; Flan-T5-XXL with 512-token sequences.
